summary: The registrant, J.P. Morgan Real Estate Income Trust, Inc., filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare routine monthly cash distributions on its common stock classes (Class I, D, T, E, Y) for August 2026. Per-share amounts are $0.0438 gross, with Class T and Y reflecting stockholder servicing fee deductions. This is a standard quarterly/monthly distribution announcement, not a special situation such as a tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring. No other material corporate event is disclosed. The filing is operational and recurring, with no strategic implications or unusual terms.
